title: Months Already Run Under a Cancelled Repayment Plan (Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery)
content:
Months already run under a cancelled repayment plan on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** are counted against the term of a new plan request.

## Clause

- When a plan on the debt was approved, the debt is again in active collection and at least one direct payment was made on it, the whole calendar months from that plan's approval to today are taken off the term.
- When a plan was approved, the debt is again in active collection and no direct payment was ever made on it, the number of consecutive missed installments that cancels a plan is taken off the term: 2 months, for every debt type (Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606), Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment, Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment, Disability Compensation Overpayment, Veterans Pension Overpayment, Home Loan Guaranty Debt).
- Otherwise nothing is taken off under this clause.

A plan counts as approved when a granted repayment plan decision is recorded on the debt; the latest one gives the approval date. Whole calendar months count a month once the day of the month of the approval date is reached again. A direct payment is any direct payment received on the debt, at any time.

## Truth table

| Granted plan decision | Debt active again | Any direct payment ever | Months taken off |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Whole months from approval to today |
| Yes | Yes | No | 2 |
| Yes | No (still in a plan) | Either | None under this clause |
| No | Either | Either | None under this clause |

**Hypothetical case.** A plan granted 12 May and cancelled; one direct payment was made; today is 3 September. The whole months from 12 May to 3 September are 3 (12 September not yet reached), so 3 months are taken off.
